description: Use this when the user says a client is new and asks to add them, or an invoice or quote needs a client that list_clients does not find. Adds a client (name and optional 15-digit UAE TRN, checked as check_trn does) to the business and returns its client_id. If a client with the same TRN or exactly the same name exists, that client is returned and nothing is created. Do not use it for a client that already exists (list_clients).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A unique string (for example a UUID) for this request: a retry with the same key returns the first result instead of writing again.

name: create_client
title: Add a client
